$comment: Official vendor sources for icon packs that are NOT redistributed with this repo. `marrow icons fetch` downloads them from the vendor's own servers onto YOUR machine, under the vendor's terms — the repo ships only these pointers and the extraction code. URLs that rotate (aws, azure) are discovered by scraping the vendor's official page for the current package link.
